### Strategy Selector
Elevated IV + extremely overbought at ATH = textbook covered call setup. Do NOT sell puts at highs. Do NOT buy LEAPS when IV is expensive and price is extended.

### CSP — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)

- ✅ Premium yield ($220P = 1.16%)

### CC — 🟢 GOOD SETUP (4/4)

- ✅ RSI 83.3 (extremely overbought)

Alternative: $245C @ $3.95 (1.68%) but only 4.4% headroom.

### LEAPS — 🔴 NO SETUP (1/6)

- ❌ Weekly RSI trending up, not recovering
- ❌ 17.1% above 200-MA
- ❌ IV Rank 60% (LEAPS are expensive)
- ❌ 0.2% from highs (no pullback)
